title: Deterministic repository audit
purpose: Convert visible Go source into explicit findings without sending the repository to an LLM.
entry_condition: doctorcode audit or doctorcode next is invoked for an accessible repository.

transitions.action: Sort findings by severity, confidence, path, and location.
For doctorcode next, build one bounded evidence packet and suppress security source excerpts.
For doctorcode audit, emit findings in text or JSON.

invariants: No M01 finding enables automatic fix or deletion.
Security evidence never includes the literal secret value.
Analyzer support is language-specific and explicit.
failure_behavior: Parse or filesystem errors fail the audit instead of returning partial PASS evidence.
restart_behavior: Audit is stateless and can be rerun against the same repository tree.
rollback_behavior: Audit and evidence packet generation do not mutate target source.
